observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR body with a mounted lens; the lens front cap is not on and the lens has a zoom range marking visible.
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with the rear buttons and mode/controls; no screen content is visible.
Photo 2 shows the lens with zoom markings “18–24 35 55” and the Canon logo on the lens barrel; the camera top dial and ON/OFF switch are visible.

claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera With 18 - 55MM Lens
claims.evidence: Photos show a Canon DSLR with a lens marked 18–55 range, but do not show “UK used”, “D650”, or any condition/cleanliness proof beyond appearance.
No photo shows shutter count, sensor condition, autofocus test, or any functional test; the seller’s text is not verifiable remotely.
The photos do not clearly show the model name/number (e.g., “750D”) on the body; only “EOS 650D” is visible on photo 0, which contradicts the seller’s stated “750D”.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says 750D, but photo 0 appears to show “EOS 650D”). Wrong model affects value and compatibility of accessories/firmware expectations.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the model text on the front/top plate (where it reads the exact model) and/or the camera’s “About/Model” screen in settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst case: treat it as not-confirmed for the stated model (use the lower comparable range for the closest visible model class).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (focus, shutter, buttons, viewfinder, and lens AF).
risks.proof: Request a short video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a burst photo sequence; also show the shutter firing and image preview.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case: assume typical used DSLR issues possible; do not pay top-of-range).

risks.proof: Request close-up photos of lens glass (front and rear elements) under light, plus a photo of a bright wall at f/8 to reveal haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition uncertain (worst case: assume some wear that may reduce sharpness).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (battery, charger, memory card, strap). Photos don’t show what’s included.
risks.proof: Ask for a single photo laid out showing every included item (battery, charger, strap, lens caps, USB cable, manual, memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/unknown bundle (worst case: value reduced if charger/battery/caps are missing).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo showing the exact camera model text on the body (and/or a settings screen showing model).
Short video test: power on → autofocus on a target → take a few shots → show playback.
Close-up photos of lens front and rear glass under light (and a sample shot of a bright wall).
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card).
response.reason: The photos suggest a Canon DSLR with an 18–55 lens, but the seller’s stated model (750D) is not reliably confirmed and appears inconsistent with what’s visible on the body. Without proof of the exact model and working condition, a safe price cannot be selected confidently.
